provenance.asset_description: Virtual Tabletops: White text with a dark blue outline overlayed over a blue tinted illustration  of the pathfinder and starfinder iconics. To the right of the text logo is a gameplay screenshot character icons in a map of a sewer system. In the bottom right of the sewer system is a large room that the sewage flow is draining into and in the center of that drain is a large spore covered dinosaur
